purpose: A small, non-interactive label for a status, a count or a category, coloured by severity. Use it to tag or count, never to act.

notFor.case: A filter or selection the person can toggle or remove.
A person's presence (online, away) on an avatar.
A message that needs a title, text or actions.

Default.meaning: Static; Variant and Appearance set the look.
Default.visual: soft: Status/<severity>/surface fill with Status/<severity>/content text; solid: Status/<severity>/surface-solid with Status/<severity>/on-solid; outline: no fill, Status/<severity>/border edge, Status/<severity>/content text; ghost: text only. A dot is always solid.

a11y.keyboard: Not focusable: a label, never a control.
notes: Colour is never the only signal: the label says what it means. An icon-only badge needs an accessible name.
Fill, text and edge move on use-hover when the app changes the variant (recipes/motion.ts).

openQuestions: Reduced motion: should the colour transitions (use-hover) be dropped?
